changes: Twelve closed door pairs on the four yard/quay sheds receive individually bevelled boards.
Tapered straps connect to segmented hinge barrels and fixed reveal brackets.
Forged pull handles have clear hand openings; the hasp passes through an open staple on a fixed mounting plate.
The original generated green/red colour images are read unchanged, with explicit per-board atlas UVs and varied board selection.
A closed rectangular backing preserves coverage through joints and bevelled outer corners.

preview.type: CPU rendering of exported geometry with current albedo and atlas mapping
preview.limitations: Approximate lighting. No engine normal mapping, GI, weathering or measured performance.

integration.warning: The independent window and door stages both replace the east/west OBJ files. Use the verified combined set; copying both separate files would overwrite one change.
native_followup: Resume native work only after the user's offline restriction is lifted. Read fresh editor/project/compile/play/unsaved state.
Recheck all before hashes and inspect any changed source before importing.
Compile unused candidate models and review existing normal viewport views, preserving scene, camera, tab and play state.
Review both paint variants, board UVs, hinge mounts, latch clearances, shadows and distance aliasing. Measure the added mesh cost.
After acceptance, integrate the scoped builder into the canonical map writer and promote through the editor. Save and recheck persistence.
